basis: Mayur Kamat describes AI uses at companies and criticizes expanding short messages only to compress them again.
reported_outcomes: Illustrative communication pattern; no evaluated intervention.
proposed_outcomes: Question unnecessary generation and reader burden.
limits: Longer text can add necessary context or accessibility. Company productivity claims are rough self-reports, not evidence for this communication heuristic.
review_note: Keep as counterexample to output volume, supporting goal-first and stopping cards.
practitioner: Compare the information the reader needs, not word count alone.
coverage: Read metadata/intro and complete relevant exchanges with surrounding discussion at the locators below; not the full episode.
